description_en: Queries clients that have applied for access credentials in unique-certificate-per-device authentication mode in an ApsaraMQ for MQTT instance
description_zh: 用于查询指定实例下有哪些设备申请了设备访问凭证（一机一密）
kebab_example: aliyun onsmqtt list-device-credential-client-id --instance-id mqtt-xxxxxxxx --group-id GID_xxx --page-size 100 --api-version 2020-04-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDeviceCredentialClientId

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Cloud Message Queue MQTT version instance, which must match the actual instance ID used by the client. You can obtain this ID from the Instance Details page in the console
parameters.help_zh: 云消息队列 MQTT 版实例的ID，一定要和客户端实际使用的实例ID匹配。您可以在控制台实例详情页面获取该ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: Group ID of the MQTT version of the micro message queue
parameters.help_zh: 微消息队列 MQTT 版的 Group ID
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: Indicates the page number of the returned results. The starting page is counted from 1
parameters.help_zh: 查询第几页的返回结果。起始页从第1页开始计算
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of query records to display per page.
Value range: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh:
每页最多显示几条查询记录。

取值范围：1~100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: Token for starting the next page query
parameters.name: next_token

NextToken.description_en:
Indicates whether there is a token (Token) for the next query. Values:

For the first query and when there is no next query, this field does not need to be filled.

If there is a next query, the value should be the NextToken returned from the previous API call
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值

PageNo.description_en: The current page number of the returned query records
PageNo.description_zh: 当前返回的查询记录是第几页

PageSize.description_en: The maximum number of results to display per page
PageSize.description_zh: 每页显示的最大结果数

RequestId.description_en: Public parameters, each request ID is unique and can be used for troubleshooting and problem localization
RequestId.description_zh: 公共参数，每个请求的ID都是唯一的，可用于排查和定位问题
